description: This file is a shell script that implements tests for Git's untracked cache functionality. It contains setup steps, test cases, and verification of the cache behavior during various Git operations such as status, commit, and checkout, particularly focusing on the correctness and performance aspects of the untracked cache feature.

methods.name: sync_mtime
methods.description: Synchronizes the modification time of all directories in the current directory tree to avoid lazy filesystem updates that could interfere with tests.

methods.name: avoid_racy
methods.description: Introduces a sleep delay to avoid race conditions in filesystem timestamp updates.

methods.name: get_relevant_traces
methods.description: Parses the trace output to extract relevant statistical data related to directory reads during Git operations.
